about_the_game:
"MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN AGAIN!"

Donald Trump's second term in office has shaken up the very foundations of the 21st Century's Global Order... take your seat in the oval office and work to implement President Trumps agenda to Make America Great Again... Again!

Is it time to break trade agreements with the rest of the world?  Bring Panama and Greenland into America's control?  And Canada will most certainly be excited to be the 51st State. 

To China and Russia, the US President continues to be unpredictable - how will they react? In Western Europe, leaders are shaken by their new reality and realize they may have to make hard decisions now that America can no longer be relied upon.

How will this play out? Will you assume Trump's role as the new US leader and guide America to renewed Greatness? Or will you instead lead another nation and take advantage of a potentially dysfunctional America to further your own ambitions?

This DLC adds the following to Supreme Ruler 2030:

  • New Campaign starting in March 2025 to enact Trump's agenda

  • New Sandbox starting on US Inauguration Day, January 20, 2025

  • Updated "Modern World" relationships, leaders, and regional economies

  • Take control as President Donald Trump, or try to minimize the damage as another World Leader
